lessons.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'
lessons.title_zh: 聖嬰現象讓太平洋如發燒般滾燙，東亞各地飽受強烈颱風侵襲

paragraphs.en: East Asia and Southeast Asia have recently experienced an unusual wave of powerful storms worsened by the El Nino climate pattern. This extreme weather has caused dozens of deaths, closed major transportation hubs, and destroyed agricultural fields as well as local infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 東亞與東南亞地區最近經歷了一波異常強烈的風暴，並因聖嬰氣候現象而惡化。這種極端天氣已造成數十人死亡、主要交通樞紐關閉，並摧毀了農田以及當地基礎設施。

paragraphs.en: In October, a massive storm packing winds of up to 295 kilometers per hour threatened Taiwan. Although it did not make direct landfall, the outer bands forced hundreds of flight cancellations across Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Japan, while also cutting power to thousands of homes in Japan and the Philippines.
paragraphs.zh: 十月份時，一場風速高達每小時295公里的巨大風暴對台灣構成威脅。雖然它沒有直接登陸，但其外圍環流迫使香港、台灣和日本取消了數百個航班，同時也切斷了日本和菲律賓數千戶家庭的電力。

paragraphs.en: The Pacific Ocean has been heated to record levels because of this climate phenomenon, providing plenty of energy for storms. Experts explain that warmer waters cause typhoons to form further east and stay strong for longer periods, leading to higher rainfall and severe flooding.
paragraphs.zh: 由於此氣候現象，太平洋已被加熱到創紀錄的程度，為風暴提供了充足的能量。專家解釋，較暖的海水導致颱風在更偏東的地方形成並維持強勢更長時間，從而導致降雨量增加和嚴重的洪水。

paragraphs.en: Climatologists warn that sea surface temperatures in the equatorial Pacific have reached unprecedented highs compared to records starting in 1949. As governments race to prepare vulnerable areas, experts emphasize that communities must improve their long-term resilience against such severe climate hazards.
paragraphs.zh: 氣候學家警告說，與1949年開始的記錄相比，赤道太平洋的海面溫度已達到空前的高點。隨著各政府競相準備易受災害影響的地區，專家強調，各社區必須提高對此類嚴重氣候災害的長期韌性。

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語當形容詞 (Past Participle Phrase as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 說明被動概念或修飾前方名詞，此處用來補充說明被氣候現象惡化的風暴。
grammar.example: East Asia and Southeast Asia have recently experienced an unusual wave of powerful storms worsened by the El Nino climate pattern.
grammar.focus: worsened by the El Nino climate pattern

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達進行某個動作的目的，此處說明各國政府競相準備的目的是為了應對脆弱地區。
grammar.example: As governments race to prepare vulnerable areas, experts emphasize that communities must improve their long-term resilience against such severe climate hazards.

grammar.explain: 強調動作的承受者，此處說明太平洋被加熱到創紀錄的程度。
grammar.example: The Pacific Ocean has been heated to record levels because of this climate phenomenon, providing plenty of energy for storms.

lessons.title: Elon Musk will face scrutiny from Democrats after midterms
lessons.title_zh: 馬斯克在期中選舉後將面臨民主黨人的嚴格審查

paragraphs.en: Tech billionaire Elon Musk could soon face intense investigations from lawmakers after Democratic candidates achieved sweeping victories in the midterm elections. Although Musk was not running for office, his businesses and political spending have placed him directly in the political spotlight. Records show that he provided over $445 million to support Republican candidates, political action committees, and outside groups. A large portion of this money, exceeding $200 million, was spent in Texas, where several of his major companies maintain their headquarters.
paragraphs.zh: 科技億萬富翁伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）在民主黨候選人在期中選舉中取得全面勝利後，可能很快會面臨議員們的強烈調查。儘管馬斯克沒有參選，但他的企業和政治獻金使他直接成為政治焦點。記錄顯示，他提供超過4.45億美元來支持共和黨候選人、政治行動委員會和外部團體。其中很大一部分資金超過2.00億美元，花在了德州，他的幾家主要公司都在該州設有總部。

paragraphs.en: With Congress now under a Democratic majority, lawmakers plan to examine the billions of dollars in government contracts awarded to Musk's companies, including Tesla and SpaceX. They also intend to question his time leading the Department of Government Efficiency, known as DOGE, during the early stage of President Donald Trump's second term. The central issue for investigators is whether Musk utilized his political influence to help his own businesses while potentially putting public funds and state resources at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著國會目前處於民主黨多數的掌控下，議員們計劃審查授予馬斯克旗下公司（包括特斯拉與太空探索技術公司SpaceX）的數十億美元政府合約。他們也打算對他在唐納·川普（Donald Trump）總統第二任期初期領導名為「政府效率部」（DOGE）的期間提出質疑。調查人員的核心問題是，馬斯克是否利用其政治影響力來幫助自己的事業，同時可能將公眾資金與國家資源置於風險之中。

paragraphs.en: Critics point out that while directing DOGE, Musk gained billions in government agreements, which could violate rules preventing officials from taking part in official matters that affect their personal finances. Furthermore, lawmakers are questioning his foreign connections and his decision to restrict Ukraine's access to Starlink internet services. Some politicians have argued that his ability to disrupt military operations for an ally without facing accountability is deeply concerning.
paragraphs.zh: 批評人士指出，馬斯克在領導DOGE期間獲得了數十億美元的政府協議，這可能違反了禁止官員參與影響其個人財務之官方事務的規定。此外，議員們正在質疑他的對外聯繫以及他限制烏克蘭使用星鏈（Starlink）網際網路服務的決定。一些政治人物認為，他在未面臨問責的情況下干擾盟友軍事行動的能力令人深感擔憂。

paragraphs.en: In Texas, Musk directed significant funds toward helping local Republican figures, such as Ken Paxton and Greg Abbott. However, these candidates were defeated as local voters favored Democratic opponents. During the campaign, political rivals accused the billionaire of attempting to buy political power in the state. Following the election results, Musk offered a brief comment on social media as political opponents celebrated their victories.
paragraphs.zh: 在德州，馬斯克將大筆資金投向協助肯·帕克斯頓（Ken Paxton）和葛雷格·艾波特（Greg Abbott）等當地共和黨政要。然而，這些候選人因當地選民青睞民主黨對手而落敗。在競選期間，政治對手指責這位億萬富翁試圖在該州買取政治權力。選舉結果出爐後，當政治對手慶祝他們的勝利時，馬斯克在社群媒體上發表了簡短的評論。

grammar.point: 關代受格省略 (Omission of Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 說明受格關係代名詞（此處為that）在子句中作為受詞時可以省略。
grammar.example: Records show that he provided over $445 million to support Republican candidates, political action committees, and outside groups.

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 說明用V-ing形式修飾名詞，表示主動的意涵。
grammar.example: With Congress now under a Democratic majority, lawmakers plan to examine the billions of dollars in government contracts awarded to Musk's companies, including Tesla and SpaceX.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 說明使用to加原形動詞來表達做某事的目的。
grammar.example: During the campaign, political rivals accused the billionaire of attempting to buy political power in the state.

lessons.title: Endangered giant burrowing frog returns to wild after tadpoles rescued from ashes of black summer fires
lessons.title_zh: 瀕危的大穴居蛙在蝌蚪從盛夏野火的灰燼中被救出後重返野外

paragraphs.en: Following the severe 2019-20 bushfires in eastern Victoria, scientists discovered puddles containing tadpoles of the southern giant burrowing frog. This amphibian is recognized as one of the state's most cryptic animals. The fires damaged large parts of East Gippsland, creating serious worries about whether the critically endangered frogs could survive.
paragraphs.zh: 在維多利亞州東部發生嚴重的 2019-20 年叢林大火之後，科學家們發現了裝有南方大穴居蛙蝌蚪的水坑。這種兩棲動物被認為是該州最神祕的動物之一。大火破壞了東吉普斯蘭的大片地區，讓人們對這種極度瀕危的青蛙能否存活產生了嚴重的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: Around 160 tadpoles were gathered and brought to the Melbourne zoo. Experts raised them through metamorphosis into frogs, and the institution successfully bred them in captivity for the first time last year. About five years later, 53 of these original tadpoles have now grown into male frogs and returned to their natural home in a distant part of the state.
paragraphs.zh: 大約 160 隻蝌蚪被收集並帶到墨爾本動物園。專家將牠們扶養至變態發育為青蛙，該機構去年首次成功地在人工環境下繁殖牠們。大約五年後，這些最初蝌蚪中的 53 隻現已長成雄蛙，並被送回該州偏遠地區的自然家園。

paragraphs.en: Adult frogs of this species can grow to the size of a cricket ball and likely live for many years. Matt Clancy, an expert in the species, explained that they spend extensive periods hidden underground inside sandy soils and forests. They remain totally still until the next rains arrive.
paragraphs.zh: 這個物種的成年青蛙可以長到板球的大小，並且可能活很多年。該物種專家馬特·克蘭西解釋說，牠們大部分時間都躲在沙質土壤和森林底下的地底中。牠們保持完全靜止，直到下一場雨到來。

paragraphs.en: The frogs only come to the surface to breed in temporary creeks and ponds when conditions become suitable. The 53 frogs were released right after major thunderstorms in areas that received significant rainfall. Ryan Moes, a specialist amphibian keeper, noted that genetic testing was performed on all collected tadpoles to prevent siblings from breeding together in the program.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在條件合適的時候，這些青蛙才會浮出水面，在暫時性的小溪和池塘裡繁殖. 這 53 隻青蛙在經歷重大雷雨後，立即被釋放到降雨量顯著的地區。兩棲動物專門飼養員萊恩·莫斯指出，所有收集到的蝌蚪都進行了基因檢測，以防止計畫中的手足互相交配。

paragraphs.en: Before release, each frog received a tag, and song meters were set up at the sites to listen for their calls. Moes stated that the ultimate goal of the breeding program is to ensure that wild populations remain healthy and robust, and that the frog avoids extinction. However, ongoing threats like climate change, habitat destruction, and reduced rainfall continue to challenge the survival of the species.
paragraphs.zh: 在釋放之前，每隻青蛙都被做了標記，並且在現場安裝了聲音測量儀來聆聽牠們的叫聲。莫斯表示，繁殖計畫的最終目標是確保野生族群維持健康茁壯，並讓青蛙避免絕種。然而，氣候變遷、棲息地破壞以及降雨量減少等持續存在的威脅，仍舊對該物種的生存造成挑戰。

grammar.point: 目的副詞片語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用不定詞片語來表達某個動作的目的，回答「為什麼」的問題。
grammar.example: The frogs only come to the surface to breed in temporary creeks and ponds when conditions become suitable.

lessons.title: The night-sky image so incredible the NZ man behind it has been accused of using AI
lessons.title_zh: 紐西蘭男子的夜空攝影作品太驚人，因而被指控使用AI

paragraphs.en: Astrophotographer Brendan Larsen spent many hours capturing the night sky in New Zealand. His spectacular final image shows thousands of satellites crossing paths above Mount Taranaki on the North Island.
paragraphs.zh: 天文攝影師布蘭登·拉森花費許多時間拍攝紐西蘭的夜空。他那張壯觀的最終影像顯示，成千上萬的人造衛星在北島的塔拉納基山上方交錯而過。

paragraphs.en: To make this viral picture, Larsen left his camera running for two hours to take hundreds of individual shots. He then spent about forty hours layering the photos together and removing stars to reveal the hidden satellites.
paragraphs.zh: 為了拍出這張爆紅的照片，拉森讓相機持續運作兩小時，拍下了數百張獨立的照片。接著，他花了大約四十小時將這些照片疊加在一起，並去除星星以顯現隱藏的人造衛星。

paragraphs.en: Some online viewers dismissed the stunning photograph as artificial intelligence. Larsen explained that AI software is becoming so good that people without knowledge of astrophotography find it difficult to tell real images from fake ones.
paragraphs.zh: 一些網路觀眾將這張驚人的照片斥為人工智慧生成。拉森解釋說，AI軟體變得如此厲害，以至於不熟悉天文攝影的人很難分辨真實影像與假影像。

paragraphs.en: As a child, Larsen was deeply impressed by the starry rural skies of New Zealand. However, he has noticed a troubling increase in light pollution and space debris during his six years of photography.
paragraphs.zh: 小時候，拉森對紐西蘭鄉間滿天繁星的景象印象深刻。然而，在進行攝影的六年期間，他注意到光害與太空垃圾令人擔憂地增加。

paragraphs.en: Experts warn that metal particles from rocket launches and satellite reentries could affect the atmosphere and the ozone layer. Larsen hopes his remarkable photo will encourage people to discuss and protect the night sky responsibly.
paragraphs.zh: 專家警告，火箭發射和衛星重返大氣層產生的金屬顆粒可能會影響大氣層與臭氧層。拉森希望他這張非凡的照片能鼓勵人們討論並負責任地保護夜空。

phrases.phrase: tell real images from fake ones
phrases.zh: 分辨真實影像與假影像

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 用現在分詞 stunning 來修飾名詞 photograph，表示該照片本身具有令人驚豔的特質。
grammar.example: Some online viewers dismissed the stunning photograph as artificial intelligence.

grammar.point: 目的不定詞片語 (Infinitive Phrase of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用不定詞片語 to reveal the hidden satellites 來表達花費四十小時疊加照片的目的。
grammar.example: He then spent about forty hours layering the photos together and removing stars to reveal the hidden satellites.

grammar.explain: 使用被動語態 are becoming so good (在此為連綴動詞與形容詞構成狀態，另一句為被動結構) 或由 be + 過去分詞構成的被動語態，此處展示原文字句中的被動與狀態變化用法。
grammar.example: Larsen explained that AI software is becoming so good that people without knowledge of astrophotography find it difficult to tell real images from fake ones.

lessons.title: Google will let schools turn off AI, but they may also lose Search
lessons.title_zh: Google 將允許學校關閉人工智慧，但也可能失去搜尋功能

paragraphs.en: Google is introducing new rules that let schools limit students from using the company's artificial intelligence tools. However, if educational institutions decide to opt out of these features completely, they will also lose access to Google Search.
paragraphs.zh: Google 正在推出一項新規，讓學校能夠限制學生使用該公司的「人工智慧」（AI）工具。然而，如果教育機構決定完全退出這些功能，他們也將失去使用 Google 搜尋（Google Search）的管道。

paragraphs.en: This policy update arrives while numerous communities demand tighter rules regarding screen time and AI usage in schools. Many people worry that technology might harm student learning and development or create safety problems. Because of these worries, several school districts, including New York City and Los Angeles public schools, chose to ban generative artificial intelligence tools for many students this school year.
paragraphs.zh: 這項政策更新之際，許多社區正要求對學校的螢幕使用時間和人工智慧使用訂定更嚴格的規則。許多人擔心這項技術可能會損害學生的學習與發展，或造成安全問題。由於這些擔憂，包括紐約市和洛杉磯公立學校在內的幾個學區，選擇在本學年為許多學生禁止生成式人工智慧工具。

paragraphs.en: Google stated that its artificial intelligence products, such as the Gemini assistant and Google Search, will stay turned off by default for kindergarten through twelfth-grade student accounts until school administrators explicitly turn them on. This decision changes an earlier move from August when Gemini was turned on automatically inside the Google Classrooms app.
paragraphs.zh: Google 表示，其人工智慧產品（例如 Gemini 助理和 Google 搜尋）對於幼兒園到十二年級的學生帳戶將預設保持關閉，直到學校管理者明確將其開啟為止。這項決定改變了八月份時的一項早期舉措，當時 Gemini 在 Google 教室（Google Classrooms）應用程式中是自動開啟的。

paragraphs.en: Chris Phillips, who serves as the vice president of education at Google, explained to reporters that search systems and artificial intelligence are deeply connected. He mentioned that schools blocking artificial intelligence will not have access to search and will see a message indicating it is unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 擔任 Google 教育副總裁的克里斯·菲利普斯（Chris Phillips）向記者解釋，搜尋系統與人工智慧有著深厚的連結。他提到，阻擋人工智慧的學校將無法使用搜尋功能，並且會看到一則顯示其無法使用的訊息。

paragraphs.en: The technology company also introduced a guided learning principle to help students work through problems instead of simply giving them answers. Under this system, when the technology detects homework help requests, students receive step-by-step guidance rather than a single direct answer. Other technology companies are taking similar approaches to prove their products are valuable learning tools for the future workforce.
paragraphs.zh: 這家科技公司還引入了一項引導式學習原則，旨在幫助學生透過問題來學習，而不是直接給他們答案。在此系統下，當技術檢測到家庭作業求助請求時，學生會收到逐步引導，而不是單一的直接答案。其他科技公司也正採取類似的方法，來證明其產品是未來勞動市場中有價值的學習工具。

paragraphs.en: Not everyone is happy with the announcement. New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani accused the company of trying to force artificial intelligence into schools, stating in an online post that no corporation should have the power to dictate how children are taught.
paragraphs.zh: 並非所有人都對這項公告感到滿意。紐約市長佐赫蘭·馬姆達尼（Zohran Mamdani）指責該公司試圖將人工智慧強加於學校，並在網路貼文中表示，沒有任何企業應該擁有決定如何教導我們孩子的權力。

grammar.example: Chris Phillips, who serves as the vice president of education at Google, explained to reporters that search systems and artificial intelligence are deeply connected.

grammar.example: Under this system, when the technology detects homework help requests, students receive step-by-step guidance rather than a single direct answer.
